host.description: IP address to bind to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or leave blank for system default.

port.description: TCP port to listen on. Must be 113 for standard compliance, but may be changed for testing or port conflicts.

user.description: User account under which the daemon runs. Recommended: 'nobody' for minimal privileges.

maxconn.description: Maximum simultaneous connections. Set to 0 for no limit.

log_to_syslog.description: Whether to log requests and errors to syslog.

static_id.description: If set, always returns this string as the 'IDENT-ID' field (e.g., 'unknown' or 'nullid'). Empty means dynamic.

static_user.description: If set, always returns this as the 'IDENT-USER' field. Empty means use system username where possible.

deny_from.description: Comma-separated list of IP subnets (CIDR or dotted-quad with /mask) to deny. Example: '127.0.0.0/8,::1'.

allow_only.description: If non-empty, *only* allow connections from these subnets (comma-separated). Leave empty to allow all except denied ones.

response_format.description: Format string for the IDENT response. Placeholders: {remote_ip}, {local_ip}, {remote_port}, {local_port}, {user}, {system_user}.
